header_sentences: See New Testament, and Old Testament.

contexts.text: The two witnesses = the Word of both Testaments, in so far as each testifies of the Lord.
This makes a difference between the Old Testament, or Covenant, and the New.
The Word is called a Covenant, and a Testament, Old, and New; thus the Divine truth there.
Moses and the Lamb = the Word of the Old and New Testament. Explained.
